title: Hidden NPCs can't be found by guessing their ID
summary: A player who sends a message or a barter offer to a made-up NPC ID now gets the same answer as for a hidden NPC or one that isn't here, so the answer no longer shows whether a hidden NPC exists.
items: Messages: an unknown, hidden or absent NPC all answer This NPC is not available at the current location.
Barter offers: an unknown account, a hidden NPC or an absent NPC all answer This NPC is not available for bartering at the current location.
The DM still sees the detailed reason, such as NPC no longer exists.
